title: EKS control plane Terraform module: auto-repair guardrails and health orchestration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a focused set of guardrail features to the Private EKS control-plane Terraform module to enable automated repair actions, richer health checks, and safer upgrade rollouts. This ticket scopes the module changes, CI additions, and Console hooks required for proactive repair (self-healing) and operator-visible health signals. The goal is to reduce manual intervention during minor control plane drift and to surface deterministic, auditable decisions when automated repairs run.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes a configurable auto_repair block with enable (bool string), max_retries, and backoff_policy parameters
Module creates Kubernetes-native health probes (as CRDs or governor Deployments) and CloudWatch/Prometheus metrics for controlplane health aggregation
Automated repair actions are implemented as opt-in (default disabled) and produce AuditEvents / CloudTrail entries for every mutation
Module supports a safe upgrade toggle that enforces pre-upgrade health gating (checks pass before rolling control plane changes) and can be overridden with explicit approval
End-to-end tests in terraforming CI validate idempotency, canary upgrade flow, and failure rollback path
Console dashboard receives a new per-cluster control plane health panel fed from exported metrics
implementation_plan: Design: finalize schema for module auto_repair block and health_export targets (Prometheus/CloudWatch) - 1 day
Module changes: add IAM role, Lambda controller (or EKS Operator) blueprint, CRD definitions, and optional autoscaler hooks - 3 days
CI: add terratest integration that simulates control plane drift and validates repair/rollback behavior - 2 days
Observability: wire metrics to existing private-console ingestion; add Grafana/CloudWatch dashboard templates - 1 day
Rollout: feature-flag the automated repair as disabled by default; enable in dogfood accounts for 2 weeks then stage to customers - 1 day
Docs & runbook: update Confluence runbook with run/rollback commands and audit interpretation guidance - 1 day
risks_mitigations: Risk: automated repairs may cause cascading changes if misconfigured. Mitigation: default to disabled, require explicit opt-in and set conservative retry limits.
Risk: IAM permissions expansion for repair tooling increases blast radius. Mitigation: use least-privilege roles scoped per-cluster and require security review before enabling for customer clusters.
Risk: false positives from health probes preventing upgrades. Mitigation: include a manual override flow with approval logs and configurable health thresholds.
Risk: observability gaps. Mitigation: add synthetic checks and CI tests that assert metric emission before granting GA.
Risk: Terraform state drift on rollout. Mitigation: add acceptance terratest that asserts idempotency and state reconciliation after simulated interruptions.
notes_and_links: TerraTest job: ci/terratest/eks-auto-repair in Jenkins (job: eks-auto-repair-e2e)
Grafana dashboard template: k8s-controlplane-health.json in observability/dashboards
